parameters.name: backend
parameters.description: which renderer executes the frames: 'cpu' (Tachyon core), 'vulkan' (hardware ray tracing through Vulkan ray queries; experimental, spheres only) or 'auto' (Vulkan if a capable GPU exists, otherwise cpu). The TACHYON_BACKEND environment variable sets the default.

parameters.name: pixelSamples
parameters.description: number of (jittered) samples per pixel; maps to Tachyon antialiasing

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: 'default': shade with the world's lights (or a camera headlight if there are none). 'eyeLight': cheap preview like helide's default renderer: lights are ignored, no shadow rays; color * ambientRadiance * ((1-blend) + blend*|N.V|) with blend = eyeLightBlendRatio, ambientColor unused, ignoreAmbientLighting defaulting to true

parameters.name: ignoreAmbientLighting
parameters.description: ignore 'ambientRadiance' and 'ambientColor' and use a fixed built-in ambient level instead

parameters.name: eyeLightBlendRatio
parameters.description: when the world has no lights: fraction of shading coming from the camera headlight
